description: Immutable foundations of the world. These values are shared by every timeline and must not be changed by a player action or story branch.

simulationRules: A branch is created only after the story API resolves a player event.
Static variables remain unchanged across all branches.
A dynamic state describes one specific timeline.
Free variables are player-facing opportunities, not automatic consequences.

worldRules.magicSystem: The Veil responds to memory, promises, and fire.
worldRules.branchModel: One player action is submitted as an event. The API chooses the next timeline state and available actions.
worldRules.visualModel: The renderer maps dynamic variables to lights, audio, creatures, weather, object variants, and UI.
